_comment: Routing study areas = held-out Sen1Floods11 chips (test split; never used for training or model selection) whose footprint contains a mapped OSM drive network. Road counts were checked with one Overpass 'out count' query per candidate on 2026-10-18. Imagery dates come from Sen1Floods11_Metadata.geojson; the OSM network is current, so roads built or removed since the flood date are a known temporal mismatch. Default start/end pairs were selected automatically (scripts/select_demo_routes.py: 250 random node pairs in the largest strongly-connected component, >=1.5 km apart; pick = most predicted-flooded road avoided with <=40% detour) to demonstrate the trade-off; they are not real evacuation requests.

areas.name: Segura lowlands, SE Spain (A)
areas.description: Dense rural-urban road grid in an irrigated floodplain; extensive standing water.

areas.name: Segura lowlands, SE Spain (B)
areas.description: Adjacent tile to the west with lighter, patchy flooding.

areas.name: Segura lowlands, SE Spain (C)
areas.description: Severely flooded tile (more than half of labelled pixels are water).

areas.name: East coast, Sri Lanka
areas.description: Coastal lagoon area with settlements on narrow land strips.

areas.name: Southern lowlands, Sri Lanka
areas.description: Sparser rural network; tests routing where few alternatives exist.

areas.name: Brahmaputra valley, Assam, India
areas.description: Large inundated floodplain with very few mapped drivable roads (34 ways): illustrates disconnected or no-safe-path cases.
